title: A tiny fix keeps main only while no other session is live
action: Close the gap the guard's own comment schedules. AGENTS.md:37-39 grants main to "a solo `tiny` fix when no other session is live", and docs/knowledge/areas/worktree-parallelism/routing-and-visibility.md:33 states the same rule with its condition. hook_local.rs:661 drops the condition entirely (`if lane == "tiny" { return Ok(None); }`), and the comment above it says so: "left unconditional rather than guessed at. Gap named here per cell wtf-3; closing it is a separate cell." This is that cell. The comment's stated blocker — no live-session walk reachable without a new store dependency — is stale. The write-guard module already carries the pieces: store.rs:383 `is_concurrent_mode(root, exclude, strict)` is the self-excluding "another non-stale session exists" predicate, store.rs:374 `heartbeat_stale`, store.rs:364 `HEARTBEAT_STALE_SECONDS`. The caller already has the session id in scope: main.rs:345 passes `session_id.as_deref()` into `resolve_write_record`, so thread it into `check_worktree_first` (hook_local.rs:581) as one new parameter and use it as the exclusion so a session never counts itself. Gate line 661 on the condition. Two boundaries: this touches the NO-GRANT arm only — the granted arm above returns first and must keep denying lane tiny, which `worktree_first_granted_arm_denies_lane_tiny_too` (tests.rs:943) pins; and it stays FAIL-OPEN on any read error, matching the discipline at hook_local.rs:630-639, so an unreadable session store allows the write rather than refusing it. Agree with the canonical predicate `is_code_touching_lane` (verbs/state_group/workflows.rs:587-591, `lane == "tiny" && !other_live_session`), already pinned by verbs/state_group/tests.rs:1536-1540 — read it before writing so the two do not drift. Update `worktree_first_no_grant_arm_carve_outs_allow` (tests.rs:1086, tiny assert at :1090-1091) which currently asserts the unconditional allow, and add its opposite: a live sibling session makes the same tiny write deny. Leave the `.md` exemption at hook_local.rs:545-547 alone — the owner decided it stays (decision logged at the shape gate).

truths: A tiny-lane write in main with no other live session is still allowed
The same write with another live session present is denied by worktree-first
The acting session never counts itself as the other live session
An unreadable or corrupt session store fails open and allows the write
The granted arm still denies lane tiny, unchanged
The .md exemption at hook_local.rs:545-547 is untouched

artifacts.substantive: the tiny carve-out gated on a self-excluding live-session check, fail-open on error
tests for allow-when-solo, deny-when-sibling-live, self-exclusion, and fail-open
